Let F' consist of all pairs (x, v) with x and y in F. Ifthe operations on F
are + and •, define operations © and O on F' as follows:
(x, y) © (z, w) = (x + z, y + w),
(x, v) O (z, w) = (x • z + a • y • w, y • z + x • w).
(a) Prove that F', with the operations © and ©, is a field.
(b) Prove that
(x, 0) © (y, 0) = (x + y, 0),
(x, 0) © (y, 0) = (x • y, 0),
so that we may agree to abbreviate (x, 0) by x.
(c) Find a square root of a = (a, 0) in F'.
